field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: The aggregate is rebuilt from audit rows instead of source totals.
field_principles.branch_pilot_audited_ready_score: The score opens only when every independent audit gate passes.
field_principles.censoring_audit: Censoring rows prove budgets, timeouts, and terminal dispositions are symmetric and explicit.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time supports authenticity checks.
field_principles.exact_receipt_replay_rows: Each audit row verifies a branch receipt against the immutable base row hash and forced assignment.
field_principles.feature_timing_audit: Feature rows prove checkpoint selection used decision-time structural features only.
field_principles.field_principles: Principles explain why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Provenance maps fields to specs, inputs, rows, receipts, tests, and deterministic reducers.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Each failed gate records expected and observed values.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict reports dataset readiness without claiming learned guidance value.
field_principles.independent_row_recomputation: Readiness is recomputed from branch rows and per-unit evidence rather than imported aggregate fields.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declaration keeps the audit on exact row, shard, and receipt replay with no LLM.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Audit rows expose one source-unit row plus manifest, split, feature, censoring, and attack rows.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions record paths, resources, solvers, protected hashes, and planning date.
field_principles.prior_failure_receipt: Prior Exp6510 and Exp6511 failure context stays visible without becoming a dependency.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The source, shards, historical inputs, and conductor must remain byte-identical.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes attack ordering reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A content hash detects drift in inputs, rows, gates, and decisions.
field_principles.shortcut_attack_matrix: Attack rows close identity, order, length, label, effort, censoring, shard, aggregate, and headroom shortcuts.
field_principles.split_and_lineage_audit: Split rows prove train, development, and held lineages are sealed and disjoint.
field_principles.status: A terminal status proves the audit closed even when the source did not.
field_principles.tests_run: Command receipts show which validation actually ran.
field_principles.transaction_and_shard_audit: Shard and journal checks prove planned rows, terminal rows, hashes, resume receipts, and atomic receipts are consistent.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_receipt: The source receipt records existence, path, hash, parse status, verdict class, row counts, shard counts, solver state, resources, and protected hashes.
field_principles.verdict_class: Null means valid readiness. Blocked and disqualified preserve missing, incomplete, leakage, and false-receipt failures.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Oracle authority is limited to dataset integrity checks.
